FN-8DCXHHH-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 315
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/16/2024
Senate Bill 315 as introduced would allow for up to $25 million to be appropriated to the
Alabama Rural, Agribusiness, and Opportunity Zone Jobs Act Account. Pursuant to the
provisions of this bill, this bill would only become operative if the Legislature appropriates
$12.5 million or more to the Alabama Rural, Agribusiness, and Opportunity Zone Jobs Act
Account for the fiscal year 2024-2025.
Page 1

FN-8DCXHHH-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 315
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/29/2024
Senate Bill 315 as passed the Senate would: 1) rename the existing State Small Business Credit
Initiative Alabama Rural, Agribusiness, and Opportunity Zone Jobs Act Account to the
Alabama Rural, Agribusiness, and Opportunity Zone Jobs Act Account; and 2) would remove
the provision that funding for the account is limited to certain American Rescue Plan Act funds.
Pursuant to the provisions of this bill, this bill would only become operative upon the
appropriation of a minimum of $12.5 million to the account for the fiscal year 2024-2025.
